summary: Duplicate postback retries from aggregator causing large embedding usage spike
description:
Issue summary: Customer reported a sudden +420% increase in billed embedding units for their nightly scheduled batch job (daily-embeds-01) on 2026-03-09 00:00 UTC. AtlasSearch uses Dedicated capacity in eu-west. They believe their job only ran once but invoices show duplicate usage lines.

High-level hypothesis: postback aggregator retried failed deliveries without idempotency keys resulting in duplicate postbacks being recorded as distinct successful jobs. Billing reconciler deduplication relied on postback_id only; when service requeued with a new postback_id the duplicate was accepted.
impact: Customer invoiced ~38k extra embedding units (~$1,520 provisional). Customer-facing search features saw transient load but end-user impact minimal; the primary impact is financial and requires credit reconciliation.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer runs scheduled batch (daily-embeds-01) that posts embedding results to postback aggregator.
2) Aggregator receives initial postback and responds 200 OK to customer.
3) During a 502 spike at 00:03 UTC aggregator replays a subset of messages; the replay path creates new postback_id values.
4) Reconciler receives multiple distinct postback_ids for what appears to be the same job payload and records them as separate successful uploads, creating duplicate metering entries.
Note: Customer payloads in replay lacked job_id field (legacy client), so dedup key fell back to postback_id only.
logs_excerpt:
2026-03-09T00:02:59Z aggregator INFO received postback_id=pb-87a1 payload_hash=sha256:6a1...
2026-03-09T00:03:10Z aggregator ERROR upstream 502 transient
2026-03-09T00:03:11Z aggregator INFO replay enqueued postback_id=pb-87a1-r1 payload_hash=sha256:6a1...
2026-03-09T00:03:12Z reconciler INFO accepted postback_id=pb-87a1-r1 records_created=1 line_item:embed_units=15000
2026-03-09T00:03:13Z reconciler INFO accepted postback_id=pb-87a1 records_created=1 line_item:embed_units=15000
investigation_notes:
Initial triage by Support: validated spike in metering and correlated timestamps with aggregator errors. Engineering (SRE + Billing) reproduced in staging by forcing replay with new postback_ids and missing job_id. Root cause: reconciler dedup_key computation prioritizes postback_id when job_id is absent; aggregator replay mechanism generates new postback_ids on replay. A codepath introduced in 2025-11 (commit d4f2b7) added replay support without preserving original idempotency token for legacy clients.

Temporary mitigation: stopped automated replay for affected queue at 2026-03-10T09:40 UTC and enabled a reconciler config to treat payload_hash as secondary dedup key.

Permanent fix: PR 4123 implements dedup fallback using payload_hash+customer_org_id when job_id absent and prevents new postback_ids during replay for backcompat clients. Patch under review; estimated deploy to canary on 2026-03-13.
comments: 2026-03-10 08:14 - Support (Aisha): Reached out to AtlasSearch support contact (marc@atlassearch.com). Requested raw invoice lines and job identifiers. Customer confirmed client does not send job_id for legacy batch runner.

2026-03-10 09:03 - SRE (Miguel): Confirmed 502 spike in aggregator from 00:03-00:06 UTC; replay FIFO created new postback_ids. Instrumented staging to reproduce and captured duplicate reconciler entries.

2026-03-10 12:40 - Billing Eng (Lena): Suggested provisional credit while we run full reconciliation because this will affect finalized invoice. Opening INT-44321 to coordinate audit and ledger adjustments.
2026-03-11 16:02 - Customer (Marc, AtlasSearch): Thanks — request provisional credit and confirmation the fix is on the roadmap. Customer will pause their nightly job until we confirm remediation.

2026-03-12 10:18 - Support (Aisha): Applied provisional hold and requested docs for full reconciliation. Notified Finance for a provisional credit of $1,520 pending final audit (ticket notes attached).
resolution: Workaround applied: replay disabled for affected queue and reconciler configured to use payload_hash fallback. Provisional credit of $1,520 applied to AtlasSearch account on 2026-03-12 reference CR-2026-03-12-100527. Full reconciliation will run once PR 4123 is deployed and a job-level dedup pass is executed; expected final credit/no-credit decision by 2026-03-18.
customer_notes_for_followup: Customer to confirm when they re-enable nightly job. They requested a postmortem and a registry of legacy clients that may lack job_id to proactively notify customers.
